// Package diagnosticbinding parses the deliberately small, non-secret
// environment contract for the Planner's V2 bootstrap binding provisioner.
package diagnosticbinding

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	provision "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticbinding"
)

var ErrInvalidInput = errors.New("invalid diagnostic binding provision input")

const (
	DatabaseURLEnv = "DATABASE_URL"
	CourseIDEnv    = "PLANNER_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDING_COURSE_ID"
	CreatedAtEnv   = "PLANNER_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDING_CREATED_AT"
)

type Input struct {
	DatabaseURL string
	CourseID    string
	CreatedAt   time.Time
}

func ParseEnvironment(getenv func(string) string) (Input, error) {
	input := Input{
		DatabaseURL: strings.TrimSpace(getenv(DatabaseURLEnv)),
		CourseID:    strings.TrimSpace(getenv(CourseIDEnv)),
	}
	rawCreatedAt := strings.TrimSpace(getenv(CreatedAtEnv))
	if input.DatabaseURL == "" || input.CourseID == "" || rawCreatedAt == "" || !strings.HasSuffix(rawCreatedAt, "Z") {
		return Input{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	createdAt, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, rawCreatedAt)
	if err != nil || createdAt.Location() != time.UTC || createdAt.Nanosecond()%1000 != 0 || createdAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) != rawCreatedAt {
		return Input{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	input.CreatedAt = createdAt
	if _, err := provision.CanonicalBinding(input.CourseID, input.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		return Input{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	return input, nil
}

type Output struct {
	Schema          string `json:"schema"`
	Status          string `json:"status"`
	GoalCode        string `json:"goal_code"`
	DirectionCode   string `json:"direction_code"`
	CourseID        string `json:"course_id"`
	BindingRevision int64  `json:"binding_revision"`
	PolicyVersion   string `json:"policy_version"`
	BindingDigest   string `json:"binding_digest"`
	Active          bool   `json:"active"`
	CreatedAt       string `json:"created_at"`
}

func NewOutput(result provision.Result) (Output, error) {
	binding, err := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(result.Binding)
	if err != nil || (result.Status != "created" && result.Status != "already_present") {
		return Output{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	return Output{
		Schema: provision.ProvisionSchema, Status: result.Status,
		GoalCode: binding.GoalCode, DirectionCode: binding.DirectionCode, CourseID: binding.CourseID,
		BindingRevision: binding.BindingRevision, PolicyVersion: binding.PolicyVersion,
		BindingDigest: binding.BindingDigest, Active: binding.Active,
		CreatedAt: binding.CreatedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
	}, nil
}

func WriteOutput(writer io.Writer, output Output) error {
	return json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(output)
}

type FailureOutput struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

func WriteFailure(writer io.Writer, reason string) error {
	return json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(FailureOutput{Schema: provision.ProvisionSchema, Status: "failed", Reason: reason})
}
